一.note: 一，通 蜀，读zêg8，通 幺，读ieu1/iao1

二.note: 潮州话中，“二”作数词单用时都读[no6]；两位数以上时，“二”在十位或个位都读[ri7]，在百位以上都读[no6]；小数点后都读[ri6]。

几.note: 几，通“圭”读gui2，也作“鬼”，指少数，少量。寡也。

九.note: 香港九龙，丰顺留隍镇九河村等地名，以及泛指次数多的九死一生，九重天都读giu2

下.note: 下，通“基”读gê6，表示地势低，矮；通“贺”读hê6，下物食（送礼），同“下聘”。

丈.note: 长度单位读deng6，比如：丈二和尚摸不着头脑

万.note: 复姓，万俟[mog8 ki5]，源于鲜卑。

上.note: 上，读siang5，旧时乐谱记音符号的一个，相当于简谱的“1”。

么.note: 么，通 微，读mih4，什么的含义

犬.note: 潮州话说”狗“，福州话说”犬“。

sentences.text: 可及潮州人相骂，莫及潮阳人斗詏
sentences.pinyin: ho2 gah4 diê5 ziu1 nang5 siê1 mê7，mo2 gah4 diê5 iên5 nang5 dao2 a3

sentences.speaker: [无声]

sentences.text: 哦，者其
sentences.pinyin: o7，zia2 ki2
sentences.translation: 哦，这个
sentences.speaker: [阿兄]

sentences.text: 者也前近有曹朋友乎
sentences.pinyin: zia2 ia7 zoin5 ging2 u6 coh4 pêng5 iu2 honnh7

sentences.speaker: [阿兄]

sentences.text: 啊，那么就希望大家来介绍下

sentences.text: 哈，侬介绍下者其
sentences.pinyin: hah7，nang2 gai3 siau2 ê7 zia2 ki2
sentences.translation: 啊，我们介绍下这个
sentences.speaker: [阿兄]

sentences.text: 棉城者畔其蜀曹...啊...环境
sentences.pinyin: mian5 sian7 zio2 boin5 gai5 zêg8 coh4 ...a7...huang5 gêng2

sentences.speaker: [阿兄]

sentences.text: 名...额...名胜也
sentences.pinyin: mian5 ...e7...mian5 sêng2 a7
sentences.translation: 名...额...名胜呀
sentences.speaker: [阿兄]

sentences.text: 旅游景点也
sentences.pinyin: lu2 iu6 gêng2 diam6 a7
sentences.translation: 旅游景点呀
sentences.speaker: [阿兄]

sentences.text: 睇诞两位有微可介绍抑无

sentences.speaker: [阿兄]

sentences.text: 遐之其者济哇

sentences.text: 其实，我餍寄到...也行过可济地方也

sentences.text: 外口之曹景点，之曹免是人造景点

sentences.text: 侬者其实曹景点到当时
sentences.pinyin: nang2 zia2 ki5 sig8 coh4 gêng2 diam6 do6 deng1 si5

sentences.text: 实实在在 曹物真实其嘛

sentences.translation: 但是这个贼啊...这个海盗...臭红肉
sentences.speaker: [阿嫲]

sentences.text: 又亢十八缸金银到乎底
sentences.pinyin: iou2 keng3 zab8 boih4 gang1 gim1 ngeng5 do6 hu1 doi2
sentences.translation: 然后藏了十八缸金银在里面。
sentences.speaker: [阿嫲]

sentences.text: 之道者其...毋若海贼起来，人来掠
sentences.pinyin: i1 do6 zia2 ki5 ...m6 a3  hai2 cag8 ki2 lai5，nang7 lai3 liah8
sentences.translation: 话说这个...要不是海盗从海上来陆地后，人们要抓他们
sentences.speaker: [阿嫲]

sentences.text: 乃恬坫入洞竜起来尔
sentences.pinyin: li6 diam5 diam3 rib8 dang7 nng3 ki2 lai5 li7
sentences.translation: 他们总是钻进洞里藏起来哩
sentences.speaker: [阿嫲]

sentences.text: 欸，着！着！着！
sentences.pinyin: ê7，dioh8 ！dioh8 ！dioh8 ！
sentences.translation: 诶，对！对！对！
sentences.speaker: [阿公]

sentences.text: 遐海贼乎，抢劫了之曹赀
sentences.pinyin: hia6 hai2 cag8 honnh7，cion2 giab4 lieu2 zi1 coh4 zin5
sentences.translation: 那些海贼呀，抢劫了的那些钱财
sentences.speaker: [阿嫲]

sentences.text: 十八...十八缸银圆亢到之内底
sentences.pinyin: zab8 boih4... zab8 boih4 gang1 ngeng5 in5 keng3 do6 zi1 lai6 doi2
sentences.translation: 十八缸银元都藏在那里面。
sentences.speaker: [阿嫲]

sentences.text: 着！着！着！
sentences.pinyin: dioh8 ！dioh8 ！dioh8 ！
sentences.translation: 对！对！对！
sentences.speaker: [阿公]

sentences.text: 侬这有蜀句俗语诞：“汝枭过阿臭盎肉”
sentences.pinyin: nang2 zê2 u6 zêg8 gu3 sog8 ghu2 dan3：“lu2 hieu1 guê3 a1 cao3 ang5 nêg8 ”
sentences.translation: 我们这有一句俗语说：“你比臭红肉还嚣张”
sentences.speaker: [阿嫲]

sentences.text: “枭过阿臭红肉"乃是诞
sentences.pinyin: “hieu1 guê3 a1 cao3 ang5 nêg8 ”li6 si6 dan3
sentences.translation: “枭过臭红肉"就是说
sentences.speaker: [阿嫲]

sentences.text: 伊阿妹欲到之其撤走其时候
sentences.pinyin: i1 a1 muê6 ain3 do6 zi1 go3 tiag4 zao2 gai7 si5 hao7
sentences.translation: 他们的妹妹在撤走的时候
sentences.speaker: [阿嫲]

sentences.text: 伊阿妹乃毋甘走
sentences.pinyin: i1 a1 muê6 li7 m6 gam1 zao2
sentences.translation: 他妹妹却不甘心走
sentences.speaker: [阿嫲]

sentences.text: 诞曹赀若济到之间
sentences.pinyin: dan3 coh4 zin5 rioh4 zoi7 do6 zi1 gian6
sentences.translation: 说这么多的钱在这里
sentences.speaker: [阿嫲]

sentences.text: 就畀乞她兄挈条剑其头丐剁了
sentences.pinyin: zu6 bi2 kig4 ia1 hian1 kioh4 dieu5 giam3 gai5 tao5 gai3 do5 lieu3
sentences.translation: 就被她的哥哥用剑剁下了她的头
sentences.speaker: [阿嫲]

sentences.text: 伊诞汝既然欲钱，剁汝其头来之间掌赀就
sentences.pinyin: i1 dan3 lu2 gi3 riang5 ain3 zin5,do5 lu2 gai5 tao5 lai7 zi1 gian6 ziên2 zin5 zu6
sentences.translation: 他说你既然要钱，就剁下你的头在这里守着这些钱好了。
sentences.speaker: [阿嫲]

sentences.text: 掌曹赀
sentences.pinyin: ziên2 coh4 zin5
sentences.translation: 守着这些钱
sentences.speaker: [阿嫲]

sentences.text: 所以侬就诞“尔枭过阿臭盎肉”
sentences.pinyin: so2 in2 nang5 zu6 dan3“lu2 hieu1 guê3 a1 cao3 ang5 nêg8 ”
sentences.translation: 所以我们说“你比臭红肉还嚣张"
sentences.speaker: [阿嫲]

sentences.text: 就是之其出处
sentences.pinyin: zu6 si6 zi1 gai5 cug4 cu3
sentences.translation: 就是这个出处
sentences.speaker: [阿嫲]

sentences.text: 哦，是之其出处
sentences.pinyin: o6，si6 zi1 gai5 cug4 cu3
sentences.translation: 哦，是这个出处
sentences.speaker: [阿公]

sentences.text: 夫到前寡年也有人去...去探险也
sentences.pinyin: da1 do6 zain5 (zoin5) gua2 ni5 ia7 u6 nang5 ku3...ku3 tam3 hiam2 a7
sentences.translation: 但是在前几年也有人去...去探险啊
sentences.speaker: [阿嫲]

sentences.text: 拢是曹...曹后生子
sentences.pinyin: long2 si6 coh4 ...coh4 hao6 sên1 gian2
sentences.translation: 都是些，一些年轻人
sentences.speaker: [阿嫲]

sentences.text: 就执条者其...执蜀粒辫绳
sentences.pinyin: zu6 zab4 dieu5 zia2 ki5...zab4 zêg8 liab8 bin1 sing5
sentences.translation: 就带一条这个...带一卷绳子
sentences.speaker: [阿嫲]

sentences.text: 了及执曹者其...（手电）
sentences.pinyin: lieu3 gah4 zab4 coh4 zia2 ki5 ....(ciu2 diang6)
sentences.translation: 还有就是带些这个...（手电筒）
sentences.speaker: [阿公]

sentences.text: 手电是曹蜡烛
sentences.pinyin: ciu2 diang6 si6 coh4 lah8 zêg4
sentences.translation: 充当手电筒功能的是那些蜡烛
sentences.speaker: [阿嫲]

sentences.text: 蜡烛夫遘蜀个弯, 就插蜀支蜡烛照明，了...
sentences.pinyin: lah8 zêg4 da1 gao3 zêg8 gai5 uang1 zu6 cah4  zêg8 gi1 lah8 zêg4 zieu3 mêng5，lieu2 ...
sentences.translation: 蜡烛是到一个弯，就插一支蜡烛照明, 然后...
sentences.speaker: [阿嫲]

sentences.text: 条之其辫是缚到外口，者其石外口
sentences.pinyin: dieu5 zi1 gai5 bin1 si6 bag8 do6 ghua7 kao2 ，zia2 ki5 zioh8 ghua7 kao2
sentences.translation: 那条绳子是绑在外面，这个石洞外面的石头上
sentences.speaker: [阿嫲]

sentences.text: 石洞外口，又正寻入去
sentences.pinyin: zioh8 dang7 ghua7 kao2，iou2 zian3 cin5 rib8 ku3
sentences.translation: 绑在石洞外边，再寻进去。
sentences.speaker: [阿嫲]

sentences.text: 惊其迷路去其乃
sentences.pinyin: gian1 gê3 mi5 lou7 ku3 gai5 no7
sentences.translation: 是怕一会儿迷路的吧
sentences.speaker: [阿嫲]

sentences.text: 遘可内底，乃曹...曹石竜来竜去乎
sentences.pinyin: gao2 ho2 lai6 doi2 ，li6 coh4...coh4 nng3 lai5 nng3 ku3 honnh7
sentences.translation: 到很里面，就有很多洞可以钻来钻去
sentences.speaker: [阿嫲]

sentences.text: 竜来竜去拢是有曹洞，乃惊诞迷路
sentences.pinyin: nng3 lai5 nng3 ku3 long2 si6 u6 coh4 dang7，li6 gian1 dan3 mi5 lou7
sentences.translation: 钻来钻去都是一些洞，就害怕说会迷路
sentences.speaker: [阿嫲]

sentences.text: 卬做人孥子于畴昔，卬复有诞所谓探险去斯底
sentences.pinyin: uang2 zo3 nang5 nao5 gian2 he1 diang1 si5，uang2 bag4 u6 dan3 so2 ui3 tam3 hiam2 ku3 hi1 doi2
sentences.translation: 我们还是孩子的时候，曾经去所谓的探险
sentences.speaker: [阿公]

sentences.text: 卬大概爬遘第二洞定
sentences.pinyin: uang2 dai6 kai3 bê5 gao3 doin6 ri7 dang7 dian7
sentences.translation: 我们大概只爬到第二洞而已
sentences.speaker: [阿公]

sentences.text: 又内底跷兮就着，“嗷”下叫
sentences.pinyin: iou2 lai6 doi2 hieu5 si2 zu6 dioh4，ao6 ê7 giê3
sentences.translation: 然而里面令人蹊跷的是突然“嗷”一声
sentences.speaker: [阿公]

sentences.text: 毋是...乎阵可能是山狗就着
sentences.pinyin: m6 si6...hu1 zung5 ko2 lêng5 si6 suan1 gao2 zu6 dioh8
sentences.translation: 不会是...那个时候可能是山狗叫的吧
sentences.speaker: [阿公]

sentences.text: 又惊遘恬暴骂
sentences.pinyin: iou2 gian5 gao3 diam7 pu2 mê7
sentences.translation: 然后我们被吓得不行一直骂骂咧咧
sentences.speaker: [阿公]

sentences.text: 连跍落去还净事
sentences.pinyin: liang5 ku5 loh8 ku3 huan1 zêng6 se7
sentences.translation: 就连蹲下去都是问题
sentences.speaker: [阿公]

sentences.text: 又者也恬有，效有蜀曹野兽尔、蛇也
sentences.pinyin: iou2 ziê2 ia7 diam7 u6， ia2 siu3 li7，zuah8 a7
sentences.translation: 而现在也一直有存在，比如说一些野兽呀、蛇啊
sentences.speaker: [阿嫲]

sentences.text: 卬前寡年，及我老，寡人跍...跍...跍于窟
sentences.pinyin: uang2 zoin5 gua2 ni5，gah4 ua2 lao6 gua2 nang7 ku5...ku5...ku5 he1 kug8（kug4）
sentences.translation: 我们前几年，跟我老公，几个人蹲守在那里
sentences.speaker: [阿嫲]

sentences.text: 了伊人落去，我毋敢落去
sentences.pinyin: lieu2 i1 nang7 loh8 ku3，ua2 m6 gan2 loh8 ku3
sentences.translation: 然后他们下去了，我不敢下去
sentences.speaker: [阿嫲]

sentences.text: 现在者曹洞济个乞塌去
sentences.pinyin: hiang7 zai6 ziê2 coh4 dang7 zoi7 gai7 koih4 tab8 ku3
sentences.translation: 现在这些洞大多数都塌方了
sentences.speaker: [阿嫲]

sentences.text: 塌去，分遐其沙填无去
sentences.pinyin: tab8 ku3，bung1 hia6 ki5 sua1 tiang5 bho5 ku3
sentences.translation: 塌了的，被那些沙子填没了
sentences.speaker: [阿嫲]

sentences.text: 嗯，年份岂久哇乃
sentences.pinyin: ng7 ，ni5 hung7 kah4 gu2 ua7 no7
sentences.translation: 嗯，年份太久了，对吧

sentences.text: 着！然后无人上落嘛，久久就分伊塞去
sentences.pinyin: dioh8 ！riang5 ao6 bho5 nang7 ziên7 loh8 ma7，gu2 gu2 zu6 bung1 i1 sag4 ke3
sentences.translation: 对！然后也没有人出入，久而久之就被堵塞住了

sentences.text: 时代够远，了也无微..及无维修无
sentences.pinyin: si5 do7 gou3 iang2，lieu2 ia7 bho5 mih4...gah4 bho5 rui5 siu1 bho5
sentences.translation: 年代久远，然后也没怎么...甚至都没有维修

sentences.text: 遐岂久，无人去遐其...
sentences.pinyin: hia6 kah4 gu2，bho5 nang5 ku3 hia6 gai5...
sentences.translation: 那都太久了, 没有人去那个...

sentences.pinyin: bho5 nang7...ng7...
sentences.translation: 没有人...嗯...

sentences.text: 等遘此久外年先慢有外地人晓取，取出来
sentences.pinyin: dang2 gao3 zi2 gu2 ghua7 ni5 soin1 mang7 u6 ghua7 di7 nang5 hieu2 cuê7， cuê7 cug4 lai7
sentences.translation: 等到这几年慢慢地有外地人懂得寻找，把洞口找出来

sentences.text: 有，自头有，汝睇我做人子乃就复去哇
sentences.pinyin: u6 ，zu6 tao5 u6，lu2 toin2 ua2 zo3 nang7 gian2 lo6 zu6 bag4 ku3 ua7
sentences.translation: 有，以前就有。你看我作为孩子的时候就已经去过了哇
sentences.speaker: [阿公]

sentences.text: 但是...但是也久无人去...去...去行过乃
sentences.pinyin: dang6 si6 ...dang6 si6 ia7 gu2 bho5 nang7 ku3...ku3...ku3 gian5 guê3 no7
sentences.translation: 但是很久没有人去走过吧

sentences.text: 了之乎间有寡个字无若大也，写“十八洞”
sentences.pinyin: lieu2 i1 hu1 gain6 u6 gua2 gai5 ri7 bho5 riêh8 dua7 a7，sia2 zab8 boih4 dang7
sentences.translation: 然后那里有几个字但是没多大，写“十八洞”

sentences.text: 有。其...其...其石(于偏)有“十八洞”之三个字
sentences.pinyin: u6。gai5...gai5...gai5 zioh8 (he1 pian5) u6 zab8 boih4 dang7 zi1 san1 gai5 ri7
sentences.translation: 有。那石头(旁边)有“十八洞”这三个字

sentences.text: 欸，着！着！着！
sentences.pinyin: hêh7, dioh8 ！dioh8 ！dioh8 ！
sentences.translation: 诶，对！对！对！

sentences.text: 汝者欲起去也，洞口之条路
sentences.pinyin: lu2 ziê2 ain3 ki2 ku3 a7，dang7 kao2 zi1 dieu5 lou7
sentences.translation: 你现在要上去的话，洞口这条路

sentences.text: 乎间无微正式踏步栈
sentences.pinyin: hu1 gain6 bho5 mih4 zian3 sêg4 dah8 bou7 zang3
sentences.translation: 那里没有什么正式的栈道台阶的

sentences.text: 着！着！着！
sentences.pinyin: dioh8 ！dioh8 ！dioh8 ！
sentences.translation: 对！对！对！

sentences.text: 非常险！
sentences.pinyin: hui1 sion5 hiam2[6]
sentences.translation: 很危险！

sentences.text: 行毋别其去，我者毋知到底其哦
sentences.pinyin: gian5 m6 bag4 go3 ku3, ua2 ziê2 m6 zai1 do6 di7 go3 o7
sentences.translation: 不知道怎么走了，我现在不知道在哪里了

sentences.text: 之头顶还有加个微其...东山水库
sentences.pinyin: i1 tao5 dêng2 huan1 u6 gê1 gai5 mih4 gai5...dang1 suan1 zui2 kou3
sentences.translation: 那上面还有一个叫做什么...东山水库

sentences.text: 毋是哦，之其...
sentences.pinyin: m6 si6 o7， zi1 gai5...
sentences.translation: 不是哦，这个...

sentences.text: 猴子石后畔，叫做岭后水库。岭后...
sentences.pinyin: gao5 gian2 zioh8 ao6 boin5, gio3 zo3 nian2 ao6 zui2 kou3。nian2 ao6...
sentences.translation: 猴子石后面，叫做岭后水库。岭后...

sentences.text: 欸，岭后后排还再过去是底其乎？
sentences.pinyin: ê6，nian2 ao6 ao6 bain5 huan1 zai3 guê3 ku3 si6 di7 gai7 honnh7
sentences.translation: 岭后后面再过去是什么呢？

sentences.text: 再过去就是河浦，河浦哦。
sentences.pinyin: zai3 guê3 ku3 si6 ho5 pou2，ho5 pou2 o7
sentences.translation: 再过去就是河浦，河浦哦。

sentences.text: 侬盖上方有蜀个庵寺平焉，到之其岭后之其过去子
sentences.pinyin: nang2 gai2 ziên7 bang1 u6 zêg8 gai5 am1 ri7 bên5 ion7，do6 zi1 gai5 nian2 ao6 zi1 go3 guê3 ku3 gian2
sentences.translation: 那边好像有一个庵寺，在这个岭后过去一点

sentences.text: 叫做“掠鸟尾”
sentences.pinyin: gio3 zo3 liah8 zieu2 bhuê2
sentences.translation: 叫做“抓鸟尾”

sentences.text: 毋知叫做微其，我者毋忆得去
sentences.pinyin: m6 zai1 gio3 zo3 mih4 gai5，ua2 ziê2 m6 in3 dig4 ku3
sentences.translation: 不知道叫做什么，我现在不记得了

sentences.text: 叫做“掠鸟尾”、“鸟尾娘”
sentences.pinyin: gio3 zo3 liah8 zieu2 bhuê2、zieu2 bhuê2 nio5
sentences.translation: 叫做“抓鸟尾”、“鸟尾娘”

sentences.text: 我忆得，忆得专门走去于下睒看，之诞有其微其，鸡母石欸？
sentences.pinyin: ua2 in3 dig4，in3 dig4 zuang1 mung5 zao2 ku3 he1 ê6  ian1 koin2 ，i1 dan3 u6 go3 mih4 gai5，goi1 bho2 zioh8 hêh7
sentences.translation: 我记得，记得专门跑去那下面偷看，听说有一块什么，鸡母石是么？

sentences.text: 鸡母石是到之其北岩之其
sentences.pinyin: goi1 bho2 zioh8 si6 do6 zi1 ki5 bag4 ngam5 zi1 go3
sentences.translation: 鸡母石是在这个北岩这边
sentences.speaker: [阿公]

sentences.text: 到东岩之其
sentences.pinyin: do6  dang1 ngam5 zi1 go3
sentences.translation: 在东岩这边

sentences.text: 东岩其鸡母石
sentences.pinyin: dang1 ngam5 go3 goi1 bho2 zioh8
sentences.translation: 东岩这块鸡母石

sentences.text: 有人（诞）者其“食海门壅河浦”
sentences.pinyin: u6 nang7（dan3） zia2 ki5 ziah8 hai2 mung5 êng3 ho5 pou2
sentences.translation: 有人（说）这个是“食用于海门，沤肥于河浦”

sentences.text: 着！着！着！
sentences.pinyin: dioh8 ！dioh8 ！dioh8 ！
sentences.translation: 对！对！对！
sentences.speaker: [阿公]

sentences.text: 了其嘴丐敲掉
sentences.pinyin: lieu2 gai5 cui3 gai3 ka3 dieu7
sentences.translation: 然而（鸡母石的）嘴巴让人给敲掉了
sentences.speaker: [阿公]

sentences.text: 鸡母其嘴乃朝对海门，其尻屯乃向河浦乎
sentences.pinyin: goi1 bho2 gai5 cui3 li6 cieu5 dui3 hai2 mung5 gai7 ka1 ceng1 li6 hion3 ho5 pou2[6] honnh7
sentences.translation: 母鸡石的嘴巴是朝向海门方向，它的屁股是对着河浦地区，是吧
sentences.speaker: [阿嫲]

sentences.text: 食乃独独（于）海门食去，戽泡屎放给这河浦...沃田
sentences.pinyin: ziah8 li6 du2 du2 （na7）hai2 mung5 ziah8 ku3，hu3 bu5 sai2 bang3 gib4 zê2 ho5 pou2...ag4 cang5
sentences.translation: 吃是只在海门吃，然而拉屎却拉给这河浦区...用于田间沃肥
sentences.speaker: [阿嫲]

sentences.text: 后来其嘴分人丐叩掉弗食去，者拢是之曹...传说乃
sentences.pinyin: ao6 lai3 gai5 cui3 bung1 nang5 gai3 ka3 dieu7 bhoi6 ziah8 ku3，zia2 long2 si6 zi1 coh4...tuang5 suêh4 no7
sentences.translation: 后来它的嘴巴就让人给敲掉了没法进食，这都是一些...传说呢
sentences.speaker: [阿嫲]

sentences.text: 传说也是传说，但是也有之曹...其石睇来非常肖哦
sentences.pinyin: tuang5 suêh4 ia7 si6 tuang5 suêh4，dang6 si6 ia7 u6 zi1 coh4...go3 zioh8 toin2 lai5 hui1 sion5 sieu6[2]  o7
sentences.translation: 虽说是传说，但是也有这些...那母鸡石看起来非常像母鸡呢
sentences.speaker: [阿嫲]

sentences.text: 委肖，者靡其物，者石也是人为叩掉其
sentences.pinyin: oi6 sieu6(2)，zia2 mi6 go3 muêh8，zia2 zioh8 ia7 si6 nang5 ui5 ka3 dieu7 gai7
sentences.translation: 很像，这不是那玩意，就那石头不也是人为敲掉的

sentences.text: 不过侬这猴子石到之水库坝之头顶也
sentences.pinyin: bug4 guê3 nang5 zê2 gao5 gian2 zioh8 do6 zi1 zui2 kou3 ba3 zi1 tao5 dêng2 a7

ing1 ui5 ua2 gai2 u6 u6 li6 dieu5 gian6 gai7

sentences.translation: “黄昏时刻独有城门一支灯”么？
sentences.speaker: [阿嫲]

sentences.text: 我乍乃毋知！呵呵呵~
sentences.pinyin: ua2 zo3 ni5 m6 zai1 ！ he1 he1 he1 ~
sentences.translation: 我怎么不知道！哈哈哈~
sentences.speaker: [阿公]

sentences.text: 有之句俗语，老人有人恬恬诞之其物
sentences.pinyin: u6 zi1 gu3 sog8 ghu2 , lao6 nang5 u6  nang5 diam7 diam7 dan3 zi1 go3 muêh8
sentences.translation: 有这句俗语，有老人家总是说这句话
sentences.speaker: [阿嫲]

sentences.text: 我忆得以前曹学生
sentences.pinyin: ua2 in3 dig4 in2 zoin5 coh4 hag8 sêng1
sentences.translation: 我记得以前那些学生
sentences.speaker: [阿兄]

sentences.text: 就是曹物乡下曹学生
sentences.pinyin: zu6 si6 coh4 muêh8 hion1 ê6 coh4 hag8 sêng1
sentences.translation: 就是那些乡下的那群学生
sentences.speaker: [阿兄]

sentences.text: 就是曹还恬问啦
sentences.pinyin: zu6 si6 coh4  huang5 diam7 mung7 la7
sentences.translation: 就是他们还总是来问呐
sentences.speaker: [阿兄]

sentences.text: 其有人诞：老师令等...等下旰我欲过令镇
sentences.pinyin: gê1 u6 nang5 dan3：lao6 se1 ning2 dang2...dang2 ê6 gua3 ua2 ain3 gua5 ning2 dêng3
sentences.translation: 就有人说：老师你们等...等下午我要去一下你们镇上
sentences.speaker: [阿兄]

sentences.text: 也是。过斯镇，就叫 过斯镇
sentences.pinyin: ia7 si6 ，gua3 hi1 dêng3，zu6 gio3 gua3 hi1 dêng3
sentences.translation: 也对。路过那镇上，就叫 路过那镇上
sentences.speaker: [阿公]

sentences.text: 还是镇所在地尔
sentences.pinyin: huang5 si6 dêng3 so2 do6 di7 li7
sentences.translation: （棉城）还是镇所在地哩
sentences.speaker: [阿公]

sentences.text: 是也...乎?
sentences.pinyin: si6 a7...honnh7
sentences.translation: 是的...吧?
sentences.speaker: [阿兄]

sentences.text: 之其棉城...也
sentences.pinyin: zi1 gai5 mian5 sian5... a7
sentences.translation: 关于这个棉城...啊
sentences.speaker: [阿兄]

sentences.text: 之蜀曹...曹介绍也，就者些
sentences.pinyin: zi1 zêg8 coh4...coh4 gai3 sieu6 a7...zu6 ziê2 sê1
sentences.translation: 这一些...这些介绍啊，就这样了。
sentences.speaker: [阿兄]

sentences.text: 猪公及阿猪嫲欲出去佚逃
sentences.translation: 猪爷爷跟猪奶奶要出去游玩
sentences.speaker: [旁白]

sentences.text: 只鹦鹉放于乎内无人饲，得释去阿肥妹乎内其
sentences.translation: 那只鹦鹉留在家里没人饲养，得丢到肥妹的家里去
sentences.speaker: [旁白]

sentences.text: 欸，令曹人盖食若未也？
sentences.translation: 诶，你们这群人是吃了没呢？
sentences.speaker: [猪公]

sentences.text: 畴昔十一点，乃硬乎食好噢
sentences.translation: 现在已过十一点，肯定是吃过了的
sentences.speaker: [肥妹]

sentences.text: 吾只鹦鹉释于令之内，令莫擅物伊邪！
sentences.translation: 我们这只鹦鹉放在你们家里，你们不要乱动它哟！
sentences.speaker: [猪嫲]

sentences.text: 鸟糜好食若莫？
sentences.translation: 鸟粥好吃不？
sentences.speaker: [肥妹]

sentences.text: 还得落鳝鱼喏！
sentences.translation: 还得放鳝鱼呢
sentences.speaker: [鹦鹉]

sentences.text: 只鸟仔却识绝，恬学嘴学舌
sentences.translation: 那只小鸟还挺聪明的，总是学人说话
sentences.speaker: [旁白]

sentences.text: 猪嫲尔乎箱底盖操曹甚微其也
sentences.translation: 猪奶奶你那箱子里面是装些什么的呀
sentences.speaker: [肥妹]

sentences.text: 此底曹物件盖鸟仔食其
sentences.translation: 这里面的这些东西是小鸟吃的
sentences.speaker: [猪嫲]

sentences.text: 老猪弟哟，尔委知阿鸟仔尚餍食微其若弗？
sentences.translation: 老猪弟哟，你可知道小鸟最喜欢吃什么不？
sentences.speaker: [猪嫲]

sentences.text: 老妈宫粽球
sentences.translation: 老妈宫粽球（潮汕特色咸甜两味粽）
sentences.speaker: [猪弟]

sentences.text: 尔者弟怎乃向识食
sentences.translation: 你这小弟弟怎么那么懂得吃
sentences.speaker: [猪嫲]

sentences.text: 尔独委晓老妈宫粽球定
sentences.translation: 你只会知晓老妈宫粽球罢了
sentences.speaker: [猪嫲]

sentences.text: 尔乍无欲诞其物盖牛肉丸
sentences.translation: 你咋不说这个东西是牛肉丸
sentences.speaker: [猪嫲]

sentences.text: 我可挈其饲料乞伊食若莫？让乞我饲蜀下喏
sentences.translation: 我可以拿一些饲料给它吃不？拜托让我喂一下呗
sentences.speaker: [肥妹]

sentences.text: 夫尔欲饲就饲哇
sentences.translation: 那你想喂就喂吧
sentences.speaker: [高丽]

sentences.text: 是诞只物正无点奶定，令莫乞奉岂加邪！
sentences.translation: 可是说这只动物还没丁点儿大呢，你们别给它吃太多了哦
sentences.speaker: [高丽]

sentences.text: 叨叨嘀嘀，知喏
sentences.translation: 唠唠叨叨的，知道啦
sentences.speaker: [肥妹]

sentences.text: 猪公哟，尔只鸟仔可放出来泅两圈若莫？
sentences.translation: 猪爷爷哟，你这只小鸟可以放出来让它游上两圈不？
sentences.speaker: [肥妹]

sentences.text: 可喏，是诞令曹门窗得关弥弥
sentences.translation: 可以呀，可是说你们这些门窗得关紧了
sentences.speaker: [猪公]

sentences.text: 夫只若是飞走去，令艰苦去赔我
sentences.translation: 话说这只要是飞走了，还得辛苦你们去赔偿我了
sentences.speaker: [猪公]

sentences.text: 等下只鸟仔就诞：“我免费啦”
sentences.translation: 等一下这只小鸟就说：“我免费啦”
sentences.speaker: [肥妹]

sentences.text: 夫无欲同令究诐噢，吾休了来去
sentences.pinyin: puêh8
sentences.translation: 那就不跟你们细聊了，我们就此打住准备离去
sentences.speaker: [猪嫲]

sentences.text: 夫欲去就猛猛去
sentences.translation: 要是想走就赶快走
sentences.speaker: [高丽]

sentences.text: 潮州盖无公交车其邪！
sentences.translation: 潮州是没有公交车的哟！
sentences.speaker: [高丽]

sentences.text: 喂，尔欲来叩茶若勿？
sentences.translation: 喂，你想要来喝茶不？
sentences.speaker: [肥妹]

sentences.text: 阿老猪弟开始来饲鸟
sentences.translation: 老猪弟弟开始来喂鸟
sentences.speaker: [旁白]

sentences.text: 老猪弟啊，尔怎乃蜀回倒着者济
sentences.translation: 老猪弟弟啊，你怎么一下子倒了这么多
sentences.speaker: [肥妹]

sentences.text: 哦其只鸟仔若是奉岂加，变作效个鸡胿平（焉），噗~
sentences.translation: 哦一会儿这只小鸟要是吃太多，变成像个气球一样，嘭~
sentences.speaker: [肥妹]

sentences.text: 哎呀，盖底其乃响也
sentences.translation: 哎呀，是哪里在鸣响啊
sentences.speaker: [高丽]

sentences.text: 盖卖麦砂糖
sentences.translation: 是卖麦芽糖的
sentences.speaker: [肥妹]

sentences.text: 麦砂糖也，等尔久哉哦
sentences.translation: 麦芽糖呀，等你很久了哦
sentences.speaker: [高丽]

sentences.text: 害矣哦，伊家人出来其门才无关
sentences.translation: 完蛋咯，他们一家子出来那门居然没有关
sentences.speaker: [旁白]

sentences.text: 甘草橄榄麦砂糖欸
sentences.translation: 甘草橄榄麦芽糖嘞
sentences.speaker: [旁白]

sentences.text: 阿白小姐失业了者乃卖甘草橄榄
sentences.translation: 那白小姐失业了之后如今在卖甘草橄榄
sentences.speaker: [旁白]

sentences.text: 高丽嫂也，侬好侬好
sentences.translation: 包菜嫂啊，大家好大家好
sentences.speaker: [白小姐]

sentences.text: 夫新年合想也，白小姐！
sentences.translation: 话说新年顺心如意呀，白小姐！
sentences.speaker: [高丽嫂]

sentences.text: 物四条麦砂糖来卖
sentences.translation: 弄四根麦芽糖来卖给我
sentences.speaker: [高丽嫂]

sentences.text: 哇卵，者其我尚餍
sentences.translation: 哇去，这个我最爱
sentences.speaker: [肥妹]

sentences.text: 哭父哦，老猪弟尔通候出来其门岂是无阂
sentences.pinyin: mung5 hoin6
sentences.translation: 去你大爷的，老猪弟弟你刚才出来的时候这个门是不是没有关上
sentences.speaker: [肥妹]

sentences.text: 只鸟仔若是飞上天又怎乃物也
sentences.translation: 这只小鸟要是飞上天又该怎么办呢
sentences.speaker: [肥妹]

sentences.text: 尔睇令曹人奉就委
sentences.translation: 你看你们这些人就只会吃
sentences.speaker: [高丽]

sentences.text: 又我去底其有赀可赔令公也
sentences.translation: 那我上哪儿能找到钱可以赔给你们爷爷呢
sentences.speaker: [高丽]

sentences.text: 害矣，只物真是无到去
sentences.translation: 坏了，那家伙真的是不见了
sentences.speaker: [高丽]

sentences.text: 夫者只鸟仔物无到，怎乃物也
sentences.translation: 话说这小鸟给弄没了，怎么办啊
sentences.speaker: [高丽]

sentences.text: 若是乞阿猪公猪嫲知着，伊硬乎欲来追喢塞其
sentences.pinyin: cuê7 sua1 sab4
sentences.translation: 要是被猪爷爷猪奶奶知道了，他们一定会来找茬的
sentences.speaker: [高丽]

sentences.text: 夫无变就阆阆来追还伊尔，怎乃物？！
sentences.translation: 如果没办法就只能去找回来还给他们，还能咋办？！
sentences.speaker: [高丽嫂]

sentences.text: 欸，令睇，令时追着哇
sentences.translation: 喂，你们看，马上找到了哇
sentences.speaker: [肥妹]

sentences.text: 伊家人乃追鸟效乃追怪愣平（焉）
sentences.pinyin: guai3 lang6
sentences.translation: 他们一家子在找小鸟就很离谱（仿佛像在找什么奇葩一样）
sentences.speaker: [旁白]

sentences.text: 盖只鸟仔
sentences.translation: 是那小鸟
sentences.speaker: [高丽]

sentences.text: 阿高丽哟，又未是得来挈只鸟铳，只鸟乞弹落来
sentences.translation: 阿包菜呀，难不成得去拿支鸟枪，把这鸟给弹射下来
sentences.speaker: [肥妹]

sentences.text: 其弹乃死去怎乃物？
sentences.translation: 一会儿给弹死了可咋办？
sentences.speaker: [高丽]

sentences.text: 夫我阆阆爬起来去
sentences.translation: 那我还是乖乖地爬上去吧
sentences.speaker: [高丽]

sentences.text: 鸟仔，转来内哇
sentences.translation: 小鸟，回家了哇
sentences.speaker: [高丽]

sentences.text: 遐去哭也父就着也，只鸟仔愈飞愈悬
sentences.translation: 那是去他爹他大爷的，这只小鸟越飞越高
sentences.speaker: [高丽]

sentences.text: 又夫者怎乃物也？
sentences.translation: 那这样怎么办呀？
sentences.speaker: [高丽]

sentences.text: 高丽，尔夫载观也！
sentences.translation: 包菜，你可多注意呀
sentences.speaker: [肥妹]

sentences.text: 勿其赴落来遘，掷着其台湾草，罚款两百邪！
sentences.translation: 别一会儿摔下来，砸到那台湾草，罚款两百呢！
sentences.speaker: [肥妹]

sentences.text: 哦令父欲乞赴死，尔还恬乃烦恼曹台湾草
sentences.translation: 哦你老爸快要被摔死，你还总在担心那些台湾草
sentences.speaker: [高丽]

sentences.text: 夫鸟仔猛竜过来喏
sentences.translation: 小鸟快点钻过来呐
sentences.speaker: [高丽]

sentences.text: 饲料
sentences.translation: 饲料
sentences.speaker: [鹦鹉]

sentences.text: 阿老猪弟尔休了欲去底其
sentences.translation: 阿老猪弟弟你要去哪里
sentences.speaker: [旁白]

sentences.text: 哦原来盖欲去挈其饲料喏，只鸟仔独委晓奉肚定
sentences.translation: 哦原来是要去拿那饲料呐，这只小鸟只晓得填肚子罢了
sentences.speaker: [旁白]

sentences.text: 睇着愣柴柴，免还弗向愚
sentences.translation: 看着呆愣木讷的样子，还好没那么笨
sentences.speaker: [旁白]

sentences.text: 夫又盖底其乃响也
sentences.translation: 又是哪里在鸣响啊
sentences.speaker: [高丽]

sentences.text: 害矣，我欲赴
sentences.translation: 完蛋，我要摔了
sentences.speaker: [高丽]

sentences.text: 夫盖底畴乃，哦原来是老娭喏
sentences.translation: 到底是何人啊，哦原来是老母亲啊
sentences.speaker: [高丽]

sentences.text: 愚子，又尔盖食若未？
sentences.translation: 傻儿子呀，那你是吃了没？
sentences.speaker: [猪嫲]

sentences.text: 尔叫只鸟仔来诐两句
sentences.translation: 你叫那只小鸟来聊两句
sentences.speaker: [猪嫲]

sentences.text: 尔独委别只鸟仔定
sentences.translation: 你就只知道那鸟罢了
sentences.speaker: [高丽]

sentences.text: 鸟仔也，尔之两日过来委心适若弗？
sentences.pinyin: sim1 sêg4
sentences.translation: 小鸟呀，你这两天过得舒心不？
sentences.speaker: [猪嫲]

wordList.meaning: 不,不可,不好,不可以,不能
